text:
emma.ford: Heads-up for month-end  Trial promo credits (TRIAL-2024) were auto-applied to prepaid customers in pilot group; resulted in $12,350 of prepaid revenue being recognized this period that should be deferred. Affected invoices: INV-2049-880, INV-2049-881.

jason.kim: can you confirm amount and paste the query you used? we need GL lines for JE.

emma.ford: summary: prepaid total 45,000; ledger recognized this month 33,350; expected recognized 21,000; over-recognized = 12,350. SQL used: ```select invoice_id, credit_id, amount_applied from billing.applied_credits where credit_code='TRIAL-2024' and contract_id in (select id from contracts where pilot=true);```

billing-bot: billing-bot: AUTO-APPLY job 1902499000 applied promo credits to prepaid invoices for pilot cohort. Log: /var/log/billing/autoapply/1902499000.log

lisa.yang: propose JE: debit Revenue (GL 4000) 12,350; credit Deferred Revenue (GL 2005) 12,350. Memo: "Reversal of trial promo credit misapplied to prepaid commit (pilot TRIAL-2024)." Attach worksheet.

jason.kim: approve. please include invoice refs and log link. will run GL confirm once posted.

elaine.ops: creating JE now JE# 1902-TRIAL-REV-001 (pending). Will attach worksheet and billing log.

emma.ford: filing BE ticket BE-4799 to exclude trial promo credits from auto-apply to prepaid commit in pilot groups. Assigned jason.kim.

jason.kim: acknowledged — will take it. Also will run a sweep for other pilot contracts first thing tomorrow.

elain.ops: once JE posts, finance will update deferred schedule and add a note to close pack.

emma.ford: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
